title: scorzonera cana
intro: Scorzonera cana, commonly known as the White Gladiolus or White Salsify, is a perennial plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its edible roots, which have been used to support digestive health and provide relief from inflammation and other conditions. The health benefits of Scorzonera cana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Scorzonera cana include inulin, saponins, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
